what: The folder set Docs Librarian creates in the owner's Google Drive, when they choose to copy their files there. Fetched at setup by docs-librarian-getting-started. Not used when the owner leaves their files in email: then no folders are created at all.

folders.name: Receipts and payments
folders.what: Receipts and payment records for each provider

folders.name: Deadlines
folders.what: Renewal and expiry dates, and anything tied to them

rules: Ask the owner before creating anything.
Never overwrite or rename a folder that is already there; ask first.
The index holds the details and the link. A file the owner keeps in email is never copied.
Say in one line what was created and where.
